function statement(sql,args=[]){return {bind(...values){return statement(sql,values)},async all(){return {results:sqlite.prepare(sql).all(...args)}},async first(){return sqlite.prepare(sql).get(...args)||null},async run(){const r=sqlite.prepare(sql).run(...args);return {meta:{changes:Number(r.changes)}}}}}
